text:
alex: Quick sync — v2 rollout milestone check. We're entering canary week for slice A/B. Can owners confirm readiness and any leftover deps? 

maria: Owning slice A (runtime) — tracking one perf regression on 1.3.2 => looking into kernel fallback. Canary images built, just waiting infra to flip traffic (~10%). :clock10:

pranav: Slice B (api-gateway) owner here. SDK team needs a minor header change landed before canary. PR #4828 is ready, waiting approvals. @kevin can you review?

kevin: on it. I'll try to finish review by EOD. main concern is backwards header parsing — added a compatibility shim.

carla: SDK lead — bumping patch to include header change. We'll cut a canary client 2.4.1. Need runtime flag to be toggled to opt-in.

alex: Thanks. Small reminder: deprecation notice for v1 endpoints goes live Tue 12:00 UTC. If canary shows regressions we hold and delay by 48h.

maria: Noted. Current plan: run canary at 20% for 2h, 50% for 4h, then full. Observability owners: please watch 95p latency and error rate.

pranav: Telemetry pings set. @devex-bot will send checkpoints. Incident thresholds: 95p > 350ms or 5xx > 0.5%.

devex-bot: scheduled: canary-checkpoint at 2026-03-18T14:00Z, 2026-03-18T16:00Z. Will post summary to #eng-sre.

kevin: Quick PR note for reviewers: diff shows shim in gateway parsing: 
```diff
- header = req.get('x-cust')
+ header = req.get('x-cust') or req.get('x-cust-legacy')
```

carla: SDK clients will accept both headers and prefer x-cust. We'll tag the release and add docs.

alex: Blockers?

maria: One: perf regression mitigation ETA tomorrow morning. Two: autoscale tweak for 50% slice ramp. Need eng-infra to confirm instance templates.

pranav: Dep: feature flag service needs a minor rollout config change. @oncall-bot can you confirm feature flag rollout window?

oncall-bot: feature-flag-service: scheduled rollout window 2026-03-18 13:45-15:30 UTC. No conflicts detected.

kevin: I'll land my review and ping QA. If everything green, carla — can you cut the SDK canary after infra flips the flag?

carla: Yes. Aim to cut at 14:15 UTC. Will post checksum and publish link.

alex: Great. Action items: 
- maria: perf mitigation PR and autoscale confirm (owner)
- prana v: gate PR review (kevin)
- carla: cut SDK canary and publish artifacts
- devex-bot/oncall-bot: post checkpoints and flag status

maria: got it.

kevin: will review now.

carla: prepared release notes snippet for marketing and support. Posting in #product later. :white_check_mark:
